outcome: maternal hyperglycemia during the post-partum period
cohort: A cohort of 369 pregnant women who underwent a 75-g oral glucose tolerance test.
finding: Early gestational diabetes (eGD) diagnosis (<24 weeks) was associated with significantly increased odds of neonatal hypoglycemia and respiratory distress syndrome, a higher requirement for specialized nutritional consulting plus metformin, and maternal hyperglycemia during the post-partum period.
